description: This is a PHP unit test class 'EmployeeImmigrationServiceTest' for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various functionalities like retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee immigration records, utilizing mock objects and test data fixtures.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeImmigrationRecordService, testing its methods with mocked DAO dependencies and fixture data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService instance and populates test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of employee immigration records for a given employee ID.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of a single immigration record by employee ID and record ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests saving (creating/updating) an employee immigration record and validates the fields.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Ensures deletion of multiple immigration records for an employee works correctly.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests searching for immigration records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of search result records based on filter parameters.
